summary: Audit of 'Hospital_Portal_v2.pdf' (HEALTHCARE): The uploaded document represents an early-stage requirement draft (14 words). It contains ambiguous language, lacks formal HIPAA, GDPR (if EU patients), HL7 FHIR, DICOM definitions, and requires NFR benchmarking.

risk_factors.title: HIPAA / Protected Health Information (PHI) Exposure Risk
risk_factors.description: Healthcare data and doctor notes must comply with strict HIPAA encryption at rest (AES-256) and audit logging for patient privacy.
risk_factors.mitigation: Enforce field-level encryption, immutable audit trails, and strict multi-tenant boundary checks.
